title: Skip and Loafer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Top student Mitsumi Iwakura moves from a tiny rural town in Ishikawa to a Tokyo high school, living with her aunt Nao. Lost on her first day, she meets Sousuke Shima, a popular former child actor with a strained relationship with his mother, and her earnest nature slowly changes the classmates around her. Seven Seas rates it Teen (13+).
life_message: It holds up sincerity, friendship and being oneself as what makes a good life in a new place.
